dataset.title: Battery material samples
dataset.description: Battery material samples will be synthesized in powder form and identified through a consistent and systematic labeling procedure.

distribution.title: Battery material samples data
distribution.description: Experimental data generated over the course of the research will include synthesis procedures and results from characterization of battery electrode samples.

metadata.description: Metadata will be stored in standard and open formats.

dataset.title: Digital characterization data
dataset.description: Digital characterization data in tabular form will be produced by electrochemical testing, X-ray diffraction, solid-state NMR spectroscopy, EPR spectroscopy, magnetometry, impedance spectroscopy, X-ray photoelectron and absorption spectroscopy, and Mössbauer spectroscopy measurements.

distribution.title: Digital characterization data
distribution.description: Digital characterization data will be stored and saved as ASCII, CSV, Word, Matlab and Python files.

metadata.description: Metadata will be stored in standard and open formats.

dataset.title: CASM software
dataset.description: The Van der Ven group's CASM software will be extended to enable the simulation of finite temperature NMR spectra of paramagnetic materials.

distribution.title: CASM software
distribution.description: CASM software will be made available under the GNU Lesser General Public License (LGPL).

metadata.description: Metadata will be stored in standard and open formats.

project.title: CAREER: HIGH-RESOLUTION NMR FOR PARAMAGNETIC SODIUM ELECTRODES
project.description: This project aims to analyze the impact of paramagnetic sodium electrodes on battery performance.
